component.name: Zapline
component.summary: Free, open-source player for your own IPTV sources

description.p: Zapline plays the sources you add: Xtream-compatible logins, M3U playlists and XMLTV guides. Every feature is free: multiple sources, multiple guides, catch-up, favourites. No account, no ads.
Zapline does not provide any content. It ships with no playlists, channels or links.
